warnings: House title block: 'แบบ 025 ศิลไพศาลา' (best-effort reading of a decorative/cursive font in the title block, e.g. หน้า02/A-01 — the design-name script is genuinely hard to read at source resolution; the design number '025' is clear, the name is lower confidence) — 'แบบบ้านยิ้มเพื่อประชาชน' series, สำนักการโยธา กรุงเทพมหานคร (same series as houses 09/12/14/16/18/19/20 already in the dataset, a different design number). 29 total sheets printed ('จำนวนแผ่น 29'): A-01..A-20 (architectural), S-01..S-05 (structural), E-01..E-04 (electrical). Small 2-story house, single-bay-and-a-half structure (3 columns A-B-C x 4 rows), RC frame with an all-steel hip roof (จันทันเหล็ก C-100x50x20x3.2mm@1.00m, ระแนงเหล็กกล่อง 25x25x1.6mm@0.32-0.34m, ตะเข้สัน/อกไก่/ดั้ง all 2C-125x50x20x3.2mm).

x_lines A-B-C and y_lines 1-2-3-4 both cross-checked: printed total row (7.10 = 3.50+3.60; 9.80 = 3.30+3.00+3.50) matches the sum of the printed segment rows on both S-02 (หน้า23) and S-03 (หน้า24) — no reconciliation needed.

Dummy y-line '3\'' (pos_m 4.95) resolves a beam mark 'B1' that spans A-B at a level splitting the 2-3 gap into 1.55m (upper, toward row 3) and 1.45m (lower, toward row 2) on the floor-1 beam plan (หน้า23) — named after the grid above it (3) per the direction rule, not the nearer one (distances are close enough that this is not a distance call either way).

Three dummy points cluster around grid 4, all resolved by the direction rule to reference grid '4' and then disambiguated by scan order (top-to-bottom) per the prime-ordering rule: '4\'' (pos_m 10.90) is a small overhang bay beyond grid 4 spanning A-B (beam B3 at its outer edge, verticals B5/B7 at A/B) — beam-endpoint rule, real dummy. '4\'\'' (pos_m 9.10) splits a small bay-window overhang beyond grid C (x 7.10-8.60, dummy 'C\'') into two stacked S2 slab panels — read from a 0.70/2.00/0.60 dimension chain on หน้า23 that sums to the full 3.30m row3-row4 gap. The fine internal beam-mark boundary within that C-C' bay (which segment is B5 vs B4 vs B2, and whether a third boundary exists at 7.10) could not be resolved with full confidence even after 2x-2.5x zoom — recorded at reduced confidence (~0.5) on the affected elements in the floor-1 beam plan file, not guessed silently. This is a minor secondary bay (bay-window/AC ledge scale), not part of the main structural grid.
Dummy x-line 'C\'' (pos_m 8.60) is a straightforward beam-endpoint case: printed offset '1.50' beyond grid C on หน้า23/หน้า24/หน้า21, unambiguous (only one adjacent named grid).

Dummy y-line '1\'' (pos_m -1.50) is the mirror-image case at the opposite end: an overhang bay beyond row 1 (A-B, beam B3 at its outer edge, verticals B5 at A/B, slab marker S2 inside) — beam-endpoint rule, before-origin case, negative pos_m per §4.

z_levels are a partial list — only levels actually seen on the pages read for this op04 (Pass-2) extraction are recorded (±0.00 datum, +0.10 walkway, +0.30 ground-floor room level, +0.85 one room, +3.05/+3.15 floor-2 finish levels from the F-5/F-6 floor-material tags on the balcony/bedroom-3 detail, หน้า21). No elevation/section (side_profile) sheet was read (out of op04 scope), so this is not a full sweep of every printed level in the drawing set.
